literal: Painful things as oneself things-understood not-approaching is-needed another-upon doing.
translation: One must avoid doing to others the things that one has personally felt to be painful.
modern: தனக்குத் துன்பம் தருபவை என்று தான் அனுபவித்து உணர்ந்த செயல்களை, மற்றவர்களுக்குச் செய்யாமல் இருக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet establishes a universal principle of empathy based on personal experience. It states that if a person has felt certain actions to be painful, they should recognize that those same actions will hurt others. The word உணர்ந்தவை emphasizes this personal realization of pain. Therefore, one must strictly avoid inflicting such deeds upon anyone else.
